name: Barbell Rear Delt Raise
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a light barbell behind your thighs using a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Brace your core, keep your chest upright, and maintain a slight bend in both elbows.
Sweep the bar smoothly backward and slightly upward behind your hips by contracting your rear delts.
Lower the bar slowly back down to the backs of your thighs under full control.
tips: Keep your torso completely upright and maintain the same slight bend in your elbows throughout.
Lift through a small, controlled arc without leaning forward or swinging the bar.
